text: Here's the recording of the <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mz1F55UoVQs&list=PLCC8lmauZTzeEP7mIsOOI4HKeeyBN2rIy|Future of Coding Virtual Meetup 8>. Once again, I've added notes and timestamps to the description. For next month, we're considering trying a different day/time than our usual Wednesday eu-evening/na-morning. Maybe a few hours later, maybe a weekend, who knows. Leave a reply in the thread if you haven't been able to join our other meetups but would love to join the next one. It might be nice to try a bunch of times and get different folks to cycle in/out.
